Everything a register can’t do

Twelve features across four areas, all running quietly in your browser while you focus on the meeting.

Attendance

Join and leave times

First join, last leave and total minutes for every participant, time-stamped automatically.

Leave and rejoin tracking

Each time someone drops out you see when they left, when they came back and how long they were away.

Late and brief joins

Flags anyone who joined late or stayed less than a minute, so a quick drop-in is not counted as attendance.

One person, one row

Screen-share tiles, camera labels and Meet buttons are filtered out, so presenting never creates a duplicate participant.

Engagement

Hand raises

Every raised hand is logged with the time and a running count per person.

Caption transcript

Captions are switched on automatically and saved as a clean, speaker-wise transcript of the meeting.

Speaking time

An estimate of how long each person spoke, based on their captioned words.

Reports and data

Automatic report

The moment the meeting ends, a multi-page report downloads, ready to print or save as PDF.

Dashboard sync

Every meeting is saved to your Meet-AI account. Re-download the PDF any time.

Automation

Participant lists

Save who should attend. Display names are matched even when they differ slightly.

Absent alerts

At the late cutoff, expected members who have not joined get an email reminder.

Host analytics

If you host the meeting, your report gets an extra host-only page with deeper insights.

How it works

Set up once in about five minutes. After that, every meeting is tracked without you doing anything.

Step 1

Install the extension

Add Meet-AI to Chrome (also works in Edge and Brave).

Step 2

Connect your account

Click Connect in the extension and approve it on your dashboard. No password is typed into the extension.

Step 3

Schedule (optional)

Add the meeting link and a participant list to get list matching, late cutoff and absent alerts.

Step 4

Join the meeting

Tracking starts on its own once you are in the call. A small “MeetTrack live” badge confirms it.

Step 5

Get the report

When the call ends, the report downloads and is saved to your dashboard.

Know who missed it, before the meeting ends

Add the people who should attend as a participant list, set a late cutoff, and Meet-AI does the checking.

  • Smart name matching. “Rahul S.” on Meet still matches “Rahul Sharma” on your list, with a match score you can see.
  • On time, late or absent. Everyone on the list gets a clear status based on your cutoff time.
  • Absent alerts by email. At the cutoff, members with an email address who have not joined get a reminder.
  • Unrecognised attendees. People who joined but are not on your list are shown separately.

Private by design

Meet-AI only reads what you can already see on your screen.

What it reads

  • Names in the participant list and video tiles
  • Raised-hand indicators
  • Captions shown on screen
  • Whether you are the host

What it never does

  • Record audio or video
  • Take screenshots of the meeting
  • Run on websites other than Google Meet and Zoom
  • Sell or share your data with advertisers

Secure connection

The extension links to your account through a one-time code that expires in five minutes.

Your workspace only

Meeting data is saved in your account and visible only to you.

Be transparent

Tell participants attendance is recorded. Our Terms ask every user to do so.

Frequently asked questions


Does Meet-AI record audio or video?

No. It reads only what is already shown on your screen: the participant list and tiles, raised hands and captions. Nothing is recorded.

Do I need to be the host?

No. Anyone in the meeting can use it. If you are the host, your report gets an extra Host Analytics page.

Which meetings does it track?

Any Google Meet or Zoom web call you join in Chrome while the extension is on. Meetings you have scheduled in your dashboard additionally get participant-list matching and absent alerts. Turn the extension off in Chrome when you do not want a meeting tracked.

Do other participants need to install anything?

No. Only the person who wants the report needs the extension. Please let participants know that attendance is being recorded.

Why is the transcript empty?

Meet-AI turns captions on for you. If the meeting language is not supported by Meet captions, or captions are blocked by your organisation, no transcript can be captured.

Someone shared their screen. Will they appear twice?

No. Presentation tiles, “(Presenting)” labels and camera labels are removed, so each person stays one row in the report.

What if a display name is different from my list?

Names are matched with a similarity score, so “Rahul S.” still matches “Rahul Sharma”. Very different names show up as unrecognised attendees for you to review.

Does it work on Zoom?

Yes, in the Zoom web client (zoom.us/wc). Zoom support is in beta; Google Meet has the most complete support.

Where is my data stored?

In your own Meet-AI account. We do not sell your data. See our Privacy Policy for details.

Which browsers are supported?

Chrome on a laptop or desktop. Chromium browsers such as Edge and Brave also work. Mobile apps are not supported.
